name: Kubernetes
body: Organization JSON-LD with a site search, a security.txt, and a sitemap named in robots.txt. But the English, Chinese, Bengali, and ten other home pages are all titled just "Kubernetes".
lesson: Add the page's purpose to its title, in its own language. Each localized home page should stand on its own in search.
summary: kubernetes.io scores 80 out of 100 (B). 0 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: other sites can frame the page.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 26 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: 20 language alternate problems
fix.evidence: / has no self reference, /docs/home/ has no self reference, /blog/ has no self reference and 17 more.
fix.fix: Each language version must list every version, itself included, and each must link back.

fix.title: 20 structured data items miss a property Google expects
fix.evidence: / Organization lacks name, /docs/home/ Organization lacks name, /blog/ Organization lacks name and 17 more.
fix.fix: Fill the missing properties so the item qualifies for rich results.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

fix.title: 1 title is shared by more than one page
fix.fix: Write a title that names what is different about each page.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 406 ms
Every page has a meta description
